title: Permanent project-local VIB identity
summary: VIB is a permanent dedicated Version-Issues-Hub branch inside each adopter's GitHub repository, not a hosted service or orchestration system. Preserve the five-stage workflow, stable checkpoints, six laws and owner-controlled lifecycle.
benefits: Persistent engineering state independent of agent sessions.
risks: Permanent does not imply branch protection or immutable refs; explicit archival and retirement remain supported.

evidence.claim: Dedicated branch entrypoint and owner authority.

decision.reason: Owner approved product identity and evidence principle; timestamp is the canonical GitHub decision record, not chat timestamp. https://github.com/vixttha/Version-Issues-Hub/issues/9#issuecomment-7172184112
